summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, attaching a press release disclosing a PDMR transaction: the Chief Operating Officer transferred 11,299 ordinary shares between his own accounts for nil consideration, outside a trading venue on June 18, 2026. This routine internal share transfer does not involve any corporate event, M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is merely a routine notification of a regulatory disclosure by persons discharging managerial responsibilities.
